proposed_targets.rationale: The existing `/api/users` collection returns every user without any filter. To fulfill user-only search by name and email, this endpoint must accept a search term and filter the `users` table by `name` and `email`, while leaving the customers and orders paths untouched.
proposed_targets.evidence: Exact f629ed74d0afbcb8b5974e546c007eb5bf36663d:server.py witness: return self.reply([dict(row) for row in connection.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table}")])

proposed_targets.rationale: The users section is the only UI surface that lists users. A search input must be added there so a user can enter a name or email and trigger the requested user-only search; customers and orders sections remain unchanged.
proposed_targets.evidence:
Exact f629ed74d0afbcb8b5974e546c007eb5bf36663d:web/index.html witness:

用户列表

proposed_targets.rationale: This script currently loads the full user list from `/api/users` and renders only names. It must read the search input and pass the name/email query to the existing user endpoint so the UI reflects search results, while the existing customer fetch remains untouched.
proposed_targets.evidence: Exact f629ed74d0afbcb8b5974e546c007eb5bf36663d:web/app.js witness: const users = await fetch('/api/users').then(response => response.json());
